entries.rationale: C03b reconciles all 29 primitive candidates through one aggregate receipt: 22 package migrations and 2 dashboard rebindings remain rooted in the Atlas package chain, 3 dormant app primitives are retired, and 2 mapped live v4 primitives remain use-as-is until their DS2 sunset conditions are satisfied.

C15 records an explicit mixed six-component receipt: JsonPreview, VirtualList, and VirtualTable are package-migrated with symbol-derived live dashboard consumers, JsonPreview translation remains app-owned through a typed labels adapter, and their dashboard owners are strangled; DataTable and MetricCard remain dashboard-owned use_as_is transitional winners until their exact DS2 sunset condition is met by DS4 consumer routing, DS6 negative/browser/accessibility evidence, and old-import removal; LineageGraph remains dashboard-owned use_as_is until a DS16 typed adapter and DS6 degraded/keyboard/table/export evidence exist, while C15 only removes its local status-to-authority color guessing. This receipt claims no DS2, DS6, or DS16 completion.

C12 rebinds the living operator diagnostic to generated OperatorDiagnostic and RunOperatorDiagnostic contracts, preserves projection labels opaquely in neutral posture, and renders producer evidence as accessible references through define-once package primitives.

C10 rebinds the living authored-text family to generated DecisionPacketAuthoredBlock attribution, preserves v15 trust-copy as projection material only, keeps every model author in candidate clothing, and renders verification only when producer metadata is explicitly supplied.

C14 rebinds the 11 living compound evidence components to generated projection, freshness, blocker, lineage, quantity, and verification types or to the single neutral decision-grade presentation swap point. CandidateFrame, BlockerCard, and WeakestLinkExplainer extend the same dashboard owner; four deferred visualization compounds remain use-as-is pending DS16. The mechanically derived DS2 form-family evidence edges remain unchanged and do not transfer runtime ownership.

C13 rebinds AssumptionPill, CounterfactualBadge, CounterfactualMetricChart, CounterfactualModeSwitch, ScenarioManifestPanel, and ScenarioPicker to generated scenario contracts or the interaction-only bridge. CounterfactualDelta, DualInput, DualSelector, and DualSlider remain use_as_is; the null-delta repair prevents the rejected point-collapse behavior without changing their owner. component-uncertainty-band remains wrap_then_strangle without a DS2 sunset claim, and rejected viz-chart-uncertainty-band remains rejected and unused.

C16 records an exact mixed three-component receipt: DetailLayout and FilterPanel are package-migrated with direct symbol-derived production consumers and their dashboard owners are strangled; SearchableList remains the dashboard-owned use_as_is winner in consumer_missing state because it has no production consumer, and its closure signal is a real production consumer followed by a separately adjudicated owner migration. The responsive-layout DS2 rows remain unresolved until DS4 binds one breakpoint owner and DS6 supplies browser, print, touch, zoom, and data-state evidence; component-search-field and form-search-source-selection remain unclaimed until their live-consumer and DS6 conditions are met. The seven attached flow IDs remain contract_only debt owned by DS5/DS7/DS8/DS9/DS12/DS14/DS15/DS17 because producer, artifact, bridge, consumer, verification, and semantic-negative evidence are missing; closure requires each named owner to bind runtime artifacts, lifecycle effects, a live consumer, and DS6 negative/e2e evidence. This receipt claims no DS2, DS6, or product-flow completion.
C06 rebinds the living quantity family to generated QuantityValue and lineage types, preserves non-scalar absence, and proves real decision producers render through the single dashboard owner.

C17 records an exact four-component use_as_is receipt: BottomSheet, MobileNav, PullToRefresh, and SwipeableDrawer remain dashboard-owned through the unchanged responsive barrel; the existing useBreakpoint/useIsMobile seam now consumes the generated atlas-ui breakpointProjection.runtime, with three live hook consumers and behavioral parity covering all five edges, media-query updates, useIsMobile, injected projection drift, and retained gestures. Only token-root-responsive material and responsive-shell-navigation behavior inform this bounded receipt. ui-tokens remains rebind_pending because designTokens.ts is not proven mechanically generated; responsive-breakpoint-taxonomy remains rejected; every other responsive DS2 row remains at its DS2 verdict and DS6 gate. This receipt claims no browser, print, touch-device, manual-AT, DS2, DS6, taxonomy, or component-sunset completion.

C09 rebinds the living temporal family to generated temporal DTO fields through an app-owned runtime bridge, separates valid_at, tx_at, payload as_of, source_as_of, and observed_at, and preserves the DS2-rejected component-decision-timeline as rejected material rather than inventing an authority timeline.

C11 rebinds the living trust-view family to generated VerificationMetadata, presents missing or incomplete owner metadata as explicit unknown, keeps open producer labels opaque, and inverts the former shared-to-app provider dependency through a shared bridge. DS2 material remains projection guidance only.
